paragraphs.text: The Sen Triplets are a group of legendary female artifact human wizards on Alara .

The Sen Triplets are a group of female human triplets from Esper . Like others on Esper , they have fused their bodies with etherium making them into an artifact and causing it to appear as if they have holes throughout their skin that show through their body. They are said to be masters of the mind and related magic. This is shown by their ability to take control of an opposing player and allow their player to see and play their cards for the turn.
